cand.title: The Trip: Punta Cana Edition '27
cand.excerpt: Rank 6: organized future group with RIU lodging ambiguity.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No fully named organizer, planner, buyer or event-specific DMC representative was verified. The official organizer contact is jeronimo@praediumtravel.com and WhatsApp +54 9 11 2497-8957. 'jeronimo' is the published mailbox identifier, not sufficient evidence of a person's full name, title or contract authority. Use this organizational channel to request the group-product/hotel-contracting lead and an operations counterpart; the preference for two verified named people remains unmet.
findings.futureEdition: Verified advertised departure: 14–20 March 2027, six nights, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, adults 18+. These are travel/activity dates, not publication dates, and fall inside the requested horizon. The group-travel directory marks reservations open. This confirms a marketed upcoming edition, not minimum numbers achieved or supplier-confirmed operation. Crew Match opens 10 January 2027 and the balance deadline is 1 February 2027; neither is the trip start. The advertised 20 March evening Neon Party falls outside the six-night package and requires an extension and flight adjustment.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana is a plausible guestroom-led all-inclusive leisure-group alternative in the core territory, not a city-conference play. Its official material lists 620 rooms, Uvero Alto Beach, three meeting venues/380 m² and capacity for 300 conference or 200 banquet guests; no such meeting requirement is published for this trip. Product mismatch matters: The Trip is 18+ and built around RIU parties, whereas Alltra is family-friendly. Alltra is not listed in RIU's eligible-hotel access list; do not promise equivalent RIU Party access. Any alternative requires organizer acceptance of a different entertainment proposition and hotel-approved group terms.
findings.venueCommitments: Edition-specific lodging offer: Riu Republica is the stated group meeting point; Riu Palace Punta Cana is the alternative for more comfort. Both are competing Punta Cana resorts and are offered for six-night all-inclusive accommodation, not merely shown in a preferred-hotel list. RIU Party entertainment is included subject to hotel programming and conditions. However, no signed hotel agreement, guaranteed allotment, room-block size, exclusivity or private event-space hire is published. The organizer expressly says a deposit is not confirmation and requests remain subject to availability and confirmation. Classify as announced competing accommodation choices, NOT a verified contractual group block or dedicated event-venue commitment.
findings.historicalRotation: No dated previous edition or historical host hotel was verified. The landing page says 'CARIBBEAN SERIES / 001'; this branding does not prove either a first-ever departure or annual recurrence. The group directory lists Tulum, Ibiza and Ski Week only as 'Próximamente', without dates or venues: these are programme teasers, not completed editions or evidence of rotation. No subsequent Punta Cana edition through May 2028 was verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel procurement openness is unconfirmed. Consumer reservations being open does not mean hotel sourcing is open. Travellers select a RIU hotel and occupancy on Praedium's edition page, pay a USD 50 per-person deposit through Stripe, and pay the hotel/ground-services balance by 1 February 2027; flights are quoted and paid separately through WhatsApp. The deposit does not confirm the trip or freeze the rate. Praedium identifies itself as the booking intermediary; the actual hotel contracting counterparty, any wholesaler and any destination transport operator are not named for this departure. No meeting-space RFP or overflow brief was found.
findings.organizationStructure: Praedium Travel is the commercial organizer/marketer; its terms identify PRAEDIUM TRAVEL LLC, Sheridan, Wyoming, USA, as platform operator and tourism intermediary for third-party hotels, transfers and activities. Its community-leader programme says Praedium manages collections and supplier contracting, with on-site coordination through regional representatives and independent advisers. This is a travel-agency/intermediary-led leisure group, not an association congress. No separate PCO or DMC is named for this edition. Praedium states RIU branding does not imply affiliation or sponsorship.
findings.competitiveLimitations: RIU has an edition-specific lodging and entertainment position: Republica is the meeting point and Palace the alternative. RIU's own access information names eligible RIU properties including Republica and Palace Punta Cana; it does not establish access for Alltra guests. No sold-out notice, unmet room demand, overflow requirement, block pickup or attendance total was verified. The promoter reward threshold of 25 confirmed passengers is explicitly a programme condition, not a sales or attendance statistic. No basis exists to calculate room nights or peak rooms.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Praedium through its published email/WhatsApp now, identify yourself as Alltra's group-sales team, and request an introduction to the hotel-contracting/product lead plus the departure operations lead. First establish whether the two RIU options are held under contract/allotment or booked on request, the direct/wholesaler/DMC purchasing route, actual paid passengers and rooming forecast, and whether alternatives are invited. Do not lead with an unsolicited replacement of the RIU-party package. If March 2027 is fixed, ask permission to develop a separate Punta Cana community/retreat proposal and learn the next sourcing decision date. Quote only after the organizer confirms size, dates, entertainment needs and a genuine alternative-hotel brief.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low-priority/unqualified displacement prospect for Alltra, not a verified open hotel lead. The March 2027 departure is selling RIU accommodation, but the public offer does not establish whether supplier contracting is closed or an alternative can be accepted. Consumer booking availability must not be represented as procurement accessibility. No sourced overflow route exists.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the more credible route is organizer-account development for a future, differently positioned Punta Cana group, or a later edition if Praedium confirms one. Its leader programme offers custom retreats and community trips with hotels and activity spaces, creating a potential product-development conversation. Recurrence, a 2028 edition, rotation and a future hotel bid window remain unverified; do not label this proven recurring competitive capture.
